title: Build dashboard links from PRIMUS_APP_URL instead of hardcoded domains
description:
Replace hardcoded dashboard links (the retired app.plexusanalytics.com, and a client-specific lab domain in 9 places) with a helper, primus/utils/dashboard_urls.py, that builds links from the PRIMUS_APP_URL environment variable.

PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Primus/pull/632 (branch claude/project-thread-2eqg2r, base develop).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Code landed first in draft PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Primus/pull/632 without a Kanbus record; this task records it after the fact. Board state committed on the PR branch. Not closed: closes when the PR merges.

right_now_summary: The PR replaces hardcoded dashboard links with URLs built from PRIMUS_APP_URL and awaits merge.
